WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Transferor is the owner of certain real property designated as Block 699, Lot 25 ("Lot 25") and Block 699, Lot 26 ("Lot 26") as shown on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan (the “Tax Map") (Lot 26 and Lot 25 are more particularly described in Exhibit I attached hereto and made a part hereof (collectively the “Granting Site"); and WHEREAS, Transferee is the owner of certain real property designated as Block 692, Lot 53 ("Lot 53") and Block 692, Lot 57 ("Lot 57") as shown on the Tax Map, and as more particularly described in Exhibit II attached hereto and made a part hereof (collectively the "Receiving Parcel"); and WHEREAS, the Granting Site is a “granting site” as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (hereinafter, the “Zoning Resolution"); and WHEREAS, part of the Receiving Parcel is a “receiving site” as defined in Section 98- 33 of the Zoning Resolution, as more particularly described in Exhibit IHI (hereinafter the "Receiving Site"); and WHEREAS, certain “floor area,” as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, appurtenant to the Granting Site is unused and is available for transfer pursuant to Section 98-30 of the Zoning Resolution; and WHEREAS, pursuant to the provisions of Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution, Transferor and Transferee have notified the New York City Departiment of City Planning ("DCP") of their intent to transfer (i) nine hundred (9oo) square feet of the floor area from Lot 25 to the Receiving Site, and (i) nine hundred (900) square feet of the floor area from Lot 26 to the Receiving Site (hereinafter, the “Receiving Site Rights"); and WHEREAS, a primary access easement volume has previously been transferred to the City of New York from Block 699, in accordance with the provisions of Zoning Resolution Section 98-61; and WHEREAS, Transferor and Transferee desire to transfer the Receiving Site Rights to the Receiving Site.
